patch.value: GH-847: tighten managed built-in static SDK contracts and author guidance

Track package-owned cleanup for managed built-in extension static SDK contracts: host-global author recovery guidance, a narrow Beads runtime SDK interface, and named Todos SDK imports. The generated managed artifacts must be updated through the pm-cli package workflow rather than downstream edits.

test-runs resume explains host-global --author placement in failure hints; Beads import runtime depends on a narrow structural SDK contract without a redundant namespace alias; Todos import/export runtime uses named SDK imports without module namespace aliasing; Managed artifacts, focused tests, package parity, and generated output are verified
